schema.description: A half-open window kept in whole milliseconds; finer digits are dropped. A window longer than the max_time_window of a historical source is counted in parts of at most max_time_window; only a window that needs more than 24 parts is clipped to its newest parts, which the source report states.

until.description: Exclusive upper bound; not in the future.

schema.title: SupportOperationsWindow
